title: Ctrl+Alt+Timeline
blurb: Your feed, your playlist, your paycheck, and the decades they secretly overlap.

cards.say: [Netflix mailed out its very last rental DVD in 2023], [Netflix mailed out VHS tapes until it switched to DVDs in 1999], [Blockbuster passed on buying Netflix for 50 million dollars in 2000], and [Netflix was founded in 1997 but didn't start streaming until 2007].
cards.real: Netflix never rented VHS. Tapes were too bulky to mail cheaply, so the founders bet on brand-new DVDs from the start.

cards.say: [Nokia started out in 1865 making wood pulp in Finland], [Slack began as a side tool at a company making an online game], [Twitch grew out of a site where one man livestreamed his life around the clock], and [Toyota started out as a company that built bicycles].
cards.real: Toyota grew out of Toyoda Automatic Loom Works, which made weaving looms. Its car business was spun off in 1937.

cards.say: [Kendrick Lamar won a 2018 Pulitzer Prize for his album To Pimp a Butterfly], [All I Want for Christmas Is You first hit number one 25 years after release], [Kate Bush topped the UK chart in 2022 with a song from 1985], and [Never Gonna Give You Up passed one billion YouTube views in 2021].
cards.real: Kendrick Lamar's 2018 Pulitzer Prize for Music was for DAMN. He was the first winner from outside classical music and jazz.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Running Up That Hill hit UK number one in June 2022) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Running_Up_That_Hill

cards.say: [Tom Brady was the 199th pick in the 2000 NFL draft], [Leicester City won the Premier League in 2016 at 5,000 to 1 odds], [Lionel Messi's first Barcelona deal was written on a pizza box in 2000], and [the 2016 Warriors won 73 games and still lost the NBA Finals].
cards.real: Messi's first agreement with Barcelona, in December 2000, was famously scribbled on a paper napkin.

cards.say: [The Keyboard Cat video was actually filmed back in 1984], [the very first video posted on YouTube, in 2005, was filmed at a zoo], [the Charlie Bit My Finger video sold as an NFT for over 750,000 dollars], and [Gangnam Style became the first YouTube video to hit a billion views in 2014].
cards.real: Gangnam Style came out in July 2012 and became the first YouTube video to reach a billion views that December.

cards.say: [Microsoft bought Minecraft for 250 million dollars in 2014], [Apple's third co-founder sold his 10 percent share for 800 dollars], [Nike paid a college student 35 dollars to design its swoosh], and [Instagram had 13 employees when Facebook bought it for a billion dollars].
cards.real: Microsoft paid 2.5 billion dollars for Mojang, the studio behind Minecraft, in 2014.

cards.say: [Gmail launched on April Fools' Day in 2004], [Roblox came out before the first iPhone], [the first iPhone had a front camera for selfies], and [Minecraft's first test build was called Cave Game].
cards.real: The original 2007 iPhone had only a rear camera. Front cameras arrived with the iPhone 4 in 2010.

cards.say: [New VCRs were still being manufactured in 2016], [the world's last Blockbuster store closed its doors in 2019], [Japan's last pager service didn't shut down until 2019], and [AOL still offered dial-up internet in 2025].
cards.real: The Blockbuster in Bend, Oregon, became the last one on Earth in 2019, and it was still renting movies in 2024.

cards.say: [Toy Story won the first-ever Oscar for Best Animated Feature], [Parasite was the first Best Picture winner not in English], [in 2025 a Chinese film became the highest-grossing animated movie ever], and [Mickey Mouse's first version entered the public domain in 2024].
cards.real: The Best Animated Feature Oscar wasn't handed out until 2002, for the films of 2001. Its first winner was Shrek.
src: NOT WEB-CHECKED (textbook: Steamboat Willie entered the US public domain on January 1, 2024) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamboat_Willie

cards.say: [Bluetooth is named after a Viking king from the 900s], [the Museum of Modern Art added 176 emoji to its collection in 2016], [selfie was named Oxford's Word of the Year in 2013], and [the word emoji comes from the English words emotion and icon].
cards.real: Emoji is Japanese: e means picture and moji means character. Its likeness to the word emotion is a coincidence.

cards.say: [In 2010 someone paid 10,000 bitcoin for two pizzas], [Jack Dorsey's first tweet sold as an NFT for 29 million dollars], [Nvidia became the first company worth 4 trillion dollars in 2025], and [Dogecoin was created in 2013 as a joke, named after a meme dog].
cards.real: Jack Dorsey's first tweet sold as an NFT in March 2021 for about 2.9 million dollars, a tenth of that.

cards.say: [Microsoft was founded in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in 1975], [McDonald's was once the biggest investor in Chipotle], [Starbucks is named after the ship's captain in Moby-Dick], and [Airbnb began with three air mattresses on an apartment floor].
cards.real: Starbuck is the first mate of the whaling ship in Moby-Dick. The captain is Ahab.
